bio: Software Developer at Beyond79, a precious-metals e-commerce company — working across a five-brand site portfolio on performance optimization, SEO and answer-engine optimization (AEO), and platform modernization. Also a part owner at Vernon LLC, an AI & automation consulting firm: building client systems from manufacturing-process digitization to a custom CRM now in design, and leading business development — most recently bringing Playmaker Sports on as a retainer client. Product-minded builder with a software engineering foundation: define the problem, iterate quickly, ship practical solutions.
